scenario_binding: research.cross_ai_strategy.case_symbols: PIT canonical stock roles; removals apply to tradable, qualification and explicit stock risk; retain sh000300/sh000682. Registry optical is sh600487/sh601869/sz300308/sz300394/sz300502; no claim to remove indirect optical exposure.
cross_window_rule: Each removal case improves at least one valid pre-2025 half-year by >=0.05 net wealth, reaches >=1.05 there and beats its fixed same-window comparator. Every valid half-year retains >=95% baseline wealth and MDD <=min(0.30,baseline+0.02). Separately, 2025-2026 must have a valid account and wealth >=max(1.50,0.95*fixed comparator). The disjoint later interval cannot be replaced by the overlapping continuous run. Existing later-window schema failures must be repaired and cannot be used as zero-return baselines.

basis.rationale: The required 50% continuous net gain is materially above the 1.04% baseline and below the 80.64% gain already achieved by the old policy in 2024 H2. The fixed comparator achieves 81-85% in the disjoint 2025-2026 interval. These executable historical opportunities do not guarantee their gains compound in one account. The full-pool 95% floor conservatively protects its currently identical champion economics. No new production candidate performance was available when these limits were selected.
basis.baseline_schema_failures: Two 382-session production runs complete daily execution but fail final account codec: OBSERVING cash-rearm evidence contains capital_budget_level=0.

profile_rule: Perturb one field at a time for champion and both removals. Deleted controls require proof that the config field and all executable reads were removed; an inactive override is not robustness evidence. Nominal champion floor is fixed; neighbor minimum80% and median90% of nominal detect unexplained collapse without requiring identical entry dates. Cost stress doubles actual execution costs and recomputes each account's risk.

contributor_robustness.rule: Precommitted algorithm removes the largest positive-PnL symbol from every explicit stock role after nominal replay; rerun old and new under that identical removal. New wealth must remain >=1.05. Report all symbol/industry PnL and concentration; do not enforce industry profit shares or count identical paths as independent evidence.

required_behaviors: Healthy incumbents retain capital absent structural damage or persistent cost-covering challenger advantage.
Independent qualified entrants can receive executable residual budget; historical owner/epoch identity alone cannot veto them.
Combined name/industry/correlation concentration includes outstanding execution reservations.
Account highwater/capital/chronic repair survive candidate changes.
One target per symbol, one allocator/account, immutable admission/fill attribution and idempotent partial/late/restarted execution.
participation.proof: Actual production observation -> target -> next-open real fill. No injected target or forced account state as economic proof.

simplification_targets: Remove strategic-only simulated partial-remainder CANCELLED/blank-ID replacement; retain one economic order and actual retry.
Align row-local authority and broker remaining economic-capacity checks while preserving genuine broker uncertainty.
Replace first-match strategic routes and cohort-signature streak resets with per-candidate evidence/confirmation.
Replace exclusive existing/recovery/protected/active_epoch_read_only capital vetoes with shared risk/cash/reservation/concentration budgets.
Replace global economic owner/cooldown with admission-scoped lifecycle and cause-aware symbol requalification; preserve immutable identities.
Delete duplicate successor confirmation and replaced coordination flags/branches; no permanent legacy strategy switch.
superseded_behavior_contracts: Exact old Target/Order/Fill and exclusive economic-owner/epoch trajectories.
Relative order/turnover trajectory comparisons for changed participation; explicit absolute order/cost/tail caps replace them. Preserve and report old literal results.
retained_correctness_contracts: Causality/PIT roles, frozen data, finite inputs, literal failures.
Daily decide/backtest equivalence, T+1/next-open/lot/limit/suspension/capacity and original nominal fees/slippage.
Cash/positions/tranches/fees/PnL reconciliation; unknown/conflicting identities fail closed; fills activate economic state.

non_independence: All diagnosis/design/selection history is historical comparison, never independent out-of-sample. Protected Future Holdout is never read or backfilled.
